test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Vasco da Gama was the commander of the ship, Sao Gabriel
Scurvy is caused by deficiency of vitamin C.
Vasco da Gama impressed the King of Calicut with his gifts.
Sao Rafael was a ship with three masts.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Vasco da Gama impressed the King of Calicut with his gifts**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sixth sentence of the third paragraph says "*But **the king of Calicut was not impressed with da Gama, and the gifts he brought as offerings***''. (तीसरे पैराग्राफ का छठा वाक्य कहता है, कालीकट का राजा दा गामा से प्रभावित नहीं था, और वह उपहार जो वह भेंट के रूप में लाया था)
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that the statement in the third option is not true. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से हम कह सकते हैं कि तीसरे विकल्प में दिया गया कथन सत्य नहीं है)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 3.
